title: UX/UI Designer
location: Towson, MD (hybrid, 3 days a week on site)
note: Designs on-tool displays and interfaces for power tools and connected devices, and is open to industrial design and interaction design grads with 0–3 years.

facts.duties: Design human-machine interfaces and on-product displays for tools, outdoor equipment and connected devices. Make sketches, wireframes, flows and prototypes, define icon systems and UI specs, run usability tests, and work with ID, engineering and firmware teams.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's in industrial design, interaction design, human factors or a related field, or equivalent experience. 0–3 years in UX/UI or industrial design. A portfolio of user-centered work on physical products (a digital-only portfolio is accepted if the skills transfer). Figma, Adobe XD or Creative Suite. SolidWorks, Rhino or KeyShot is a plus.
facts.apply: Apply online through the Stanley Black & Decker Workday careers site. Posted 2026-11-17.
